nodes.label: Architecture Audit and Implementation Plan
nodes.description: Full architecture audit of refraccion branch. Executive verdict: not fully event-driven. Three Vue timers discover state through REST (10s alerts, 5s dashboard alerts, 2s sensor monitors). Raw ingestion stores receipt but no consumer exists. Root causes: RC1 split state ownership, RC2 incomplete domain-event coverage, RC3 non-atomic persist+publish, RC4 missing durable consumer ops, RC5 transport≠projection lifecycle, RC6 no behavioral mobile/a11y test. 9 mobile findings (M01-M09). Complete polling inventory (7 items). Event catalog with 6 event types. Observer/listener matrix. Redis Streams audit. WebSocket/Echo architecture. 10-stage migration roadmap. Implementation backlog (TASK-001..012). Complexity review: CDC is biggest over-engineering risk, DLQ should reuse failed_jobs, full reconnect protocol is more than v1 needs.
nodes.rationale: The foundational audit document that drives the entire migration plan. Contains the root cause analysis, polling inventory, event catalog, architecture decisions, and complexity review that informed PLAN.md.
